title: Villager Trade Edit
description: Couldn't find a mod to change villager trade offers in Forge 1.20.1, so I made my own. Just use the give command to get the trader wand, right-click a villager, and easily edit their trades from top to bottom.
body:
Couldn't find a mod to change villager trade offers in Forge 1.20.1, so I made my own.

Just use '/give @s villageredit:trader_wand', right-click a villager, and easily edit their trades from top to bottom. (Note: Designed for Creative Mode only!
